blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo Xignex Trojans are marching into another divisional finals after outlasting the Cagayan Kings in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) Wesley So Cup last Thursday. The Trojans faced the Kings in their crossover semifinals matchup in the Omega Division as the second-seeded contender. Cagayan entered as the third seed. Toledo beat Cagayan twice, 12-9, in their first matchup and 14.5-6.5 in their second. QUEENS IN THE GAME OF KINGS: Hewe rules Cebu Blitz Queen Chess Tournament Toledo takes charge That’s how they booked an Omega Division finals showdown against top-seeded Sudeco-Manila Indios Bravos.
